Results.ReviewText: I needed a new grill after my Char Broil rusted out and decided to try a Weber. The E-210 2 burner is on the lower end costwise but has the features I was looking for like a closed cabinet and porcelain coated cast iron cooking grates. It heats up to high quickly and the temp is easy to manage. Although the cooking surface isn't large it easily fit 6 burgers or bone in pork chops or shish kabobs. It is sturdy and with some maintenance should last many years.

ClientResponses.Response: Hello Vince, We are sorry to hear about your disappointment with the design of your new Spirit E-210. The tank needs to be hung on the tank scale so it may hover above the hole on the bottom panel. The reason that the hole is bigger than the tank is thus you don't have premature rusting on the bottom panel and you have more airflow. We are glad to hear that your neighbor was able to assist you with this. Any other questions or concerns please reach out at reviews@weberstephen.com. Thank you.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill a week ago and have had Weber's previously and have been happy with the product overall.  My issue with this one occurred immediately placing the propane tank in the hole in the frame, which is so large that the tank SITS ON THE GROUND!!!.  Now every time I move the grill the tank falls over and I have to stand it back upright.  No big deal for someone less than 72 years of age with no chronic back issues.  This garbage can will run its course and if I outlive it, my next grill certainly wont be a weber.
Results.Title: NOT THE CADILLAC OF GRILLS I THOUGHT IT WOULD BE

Results.ReviewText: I received my new grill about a month ago and I really love it! One of the best things is the temperature control. Using the recommended grill times and temperatures on the grilling guide I was able to make perfectly cooked chicken, steaks and hamburgers. That never happened on my old grill. I also like that the side shelves fold down and it doesn’t take up as much space on my patio. I highly recommend!
Results.Title: Love this grill!

We like it very much. It’s simple, robust, nice appearance, easy to maintain, and cooking is excellent.
One single thing that concerned us is the ignition. We were not able a couple of times to turn it on (of course the propane tank was full). After replacing the battery the ignition worked but few days ago we had again an occurrence when we couldn’t start it. After several tries eventually ignited.

Results.ReviewText: I've owned and loved weber grills for years, but this model was a complete let down due to the way the plastic control knobs are secured on to the control rods. We returned the first one delivered due to one of the control knobs being extremely loose and sliding off the rod. I'm returning the second one as well and getting a refund due to another problem with the control knobs. With this unit the knob does not securely grip the rod with the result being the flame was not turned off when the knob was turned to the off position. This happened 2 of the 3 times we used. Perhaps it was assembled wrong at the store but, having issues with both of the units I received I decided it's best to move on to something more reliable.
Results.Title: Very disappointed

ClientResponses.Response: Hello John, thank you for taking your time to submit your review! Often times our customers confuse about their control knob positions. You might be setting your grill on high heat. Please keep in mind that your start position is your high position as well. The more you turn your control knob the lower your flame will be. Therefore be sure that you are positioning your control knobs correctly. If you are still having issues be sure to reach out to our support team and we will be happy to assist! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Results.ReviewText: This was my 3rd Spirit. I never had a problem with heating control until now. It simply burns too hot. With both burners on low it gets to 400. I talk to Weber 3 different times and all I got was it will cool down after  couple of weeks. It didn’t and I finally got Warner stellian to come out. They replaced the regulator but it still was too hot. The service guy suggested tourning that burner control between hot and off. That worked so you can get a finer control over the flame. You guys should have suggested that in the first place.
Results.Title: Grill too hot.

Results.ReviewText: I bought the natural gas one a month ago and it’s been great. Even cooking and perfect temperature. It’s a little small for big dinners but it’s made me better at barbecuing. Absolutely love it.

Results.ReviewText: I very much like the size of this grill and was very happy until this spring when it turned out that my cover had a crack which allowed water into the grill and rusted the control knob on the front so the spring would not work. Because of the current shutdown, I have been unable to talk to someone at Weber customer service and order a new manifold assembly and replace the defective. I still use the grill but have to shut it off at the propane tank and cannot control the heat like I used to.
Results.Title: Manifold problem

Results.ReviewText: Great experience (local hardware store assembled and delivered), great performance. This is a great gas grill! I'm glad I went back to Weber after making a mistake with a lower priced unit from a big box store a few years ago. Quality matters and this Weber has it.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
